name: dbinfo
description: Returns database metadata as a query — the function form of the cfdbinfo tag. Pass the same attributes the tag accepts (type, datasource, filter, columns, etc.), either as positional arguments or a single attributes struct; attributeCollection is expanded with explicit keys winning. Supported types include tables, columns, procedures, datasources and version. The result is delivered to the named variable just like the tag.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the variable to receive the metadata query.

params.name: attributes
params.description: Struct of cfdbinfo attributes: type (tables|columns|procedures|datasources|version|foreignkeys), datasource, filter, columns, and other tag attributes.

examples.title: List tables
examples.description: Get the table metadata for the default datasource.
